title: Senior SAP Developer
description: Our client is a well-established SAP software company developing innovative SAP solutions for an international customer base. As part of their continued growth, they are looking for an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to join their development team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and enjoys designing high-quality SAP solutions while working with the latest SAP technologies. This is a permanent role, full time, hybrid based near Zurich. Your Responsibilities Design, develop, and enhance enterprise SAP solutions using modern ABAP Develop complex applications using ABAP Objects and clean development principles Design and implement robust software architectures and technical concepts Develop and integrate SAP applications within SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud environments Build and enhance SAP Fiori applications and user interfaces Develop solutions leveraging SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Collaborate closely with product management, consultants, and customers to deliver innovative solutions Support customers with technical analysis, troubleshooting, and product enhancements Contribute to software quality, performance optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives Your Profile Several years of professional experience as an SAP ABAP Developer Strong expertise in ABAP Objects and object-oriented software development Experience developing solutions for SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Experience developing or extending SAP Fiori applications Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and SAP development best practices Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills Independent, proactive, and quality-focused approach to work Fluent C1+ German and good English language skills What's on Offer Permanent position with a stable and innovative SAP software organisation Hybrid working model with a combination of home office and on-site collaboration Opportunity to work with the latest SAP technologies, including S/4HANA Private Cloud, BTP, and Fiori Challenging technical projects with a high degree of ownership Collaborative and supportive team environment Long-term career development and professional growth opportunities Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
